name: investigate
purpose: Resolve a falsifiable question from primary evidence and preserve diagnosis-only scope.

criteria.description: Ground consequential claims in authorized primary source evidence.
Attempt to falsify the leading explanation and retain contradictions and unknowns.
A diagnosis-only request does not authorize product edits or unrelated private histories.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
The deterministic core checks report facts/coverage. Source tracing, falsification and evidence interpretation remain explicit investigative work.
